messages:
Olivia: Hi folks, first-week setup question. I migrated my Linux dotfiles to a new MacBook Air (macOS Ventura, M1) and I'm stuck on PATH/permission issues. Trying to get Homebrew, asdf, node, python, ssh keys, and 1Password CLI working. Any recommended migration order or quick checklist?
Jamie: welcome! :wave: i always do this order: 1) Homebrew, 2) ensure brew is on the shell PATH, 3) install asdf via brew, 4) add asdf shims to your shell, 5) install runtimes (node/python) and create .tool-versions.
Jamie: commands i run (zsh):
```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
# add brew to PATH for apple silicon
echo 'export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zprofile
source ~/.zprofile
brew install asdf gpg gnupg direnv 1password-cli
echo '. $(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh' >> ~/.zprofile
echo 'eval "$(direnv hook zsh)"' >> ~/.zshrc
```
Jamie: note: nodejs plugin for asdf may require gpg to verify tarballs and a nodejs release key import step.
Olivia: thanks! i had brew installed but it wasn't on PATH so `brew` was not found in new terminal. another issue: my dotfiles have a bunch of linux-specific symlinks (like ~/dotfiles/.local/bin paths). any safe strategy to migrate without breaking zsh on mac?
Matt: don't swap your main .zshrc immediately. create a ~/.zshrc.local and source it from the new file so you can roll back quickly. also check for linux-only paths in scripts (`/usr/local` vs `/opt/homebrew`). run `brew doctor` and fix flagged permissions.
Ashley: for VSCode, i keep editor settings in account sync and only track `.vscode/extensions.json` in repo for recommended extensions. avoids syncing machine-specific paths.
Olivia: SSH and 1Password -- how do folks handle SSH keys and persistence on mac?
Matt: we use 1Password CLI to fetch/provision keys sometimes. do `op signin` once per session or set up a short script. for mac key persistence, `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` (or id_rsa) keeps it in Keychain. also enable `AddKeysToAgent yes` in `~/.ssh/config`.
Jamie: small Redwood tip: don't commit secrets or private keys. commit language versions in `.tool-versions` for reproducibility across the team. check onboarding docs (internal) for any repo-specific hooks.
Ashley: direnv is handy for per-repo envs. put non-secret defaults in `.envrc` and load secrets from 1Password in your shell script if needed. `brew install direnv` then add hook to zshrc.
Olivia: anything else I should watch for on M1?
Jamie: some build tools and native npm packages need `arch -arm64` or Rosetta if you use Intel binaries. prefer arm-native Homebrew installs (`/opt/homebrew`). if you have legacy `/usr/local` installs, consider reinstalling via brew on arm.
Matt: if you see permission issues with /opt/homebrew, run the fix suggested by brew doctor; avoid sudoing brew commands. ping infra if your machine needs special corp certs.
Olivia: awesome. can someone volunteer to pair for 20-30m if i hit unexpected errors?
onboarding-bot: Hi Olivia! If you'd like a pairing session, react with :raised_hands: or tag a teammate.
Jamie: happy to pair later today. tag me and i'll schedule 30m.
Olivia: thanks everyone, i'll follow this and test installing asdf + node + python first, then migrate dotfiles piece-by-piece. appreciate the help! :heart:
